## Why This Is Asked

- Least privilege IAM for Cloud Run service accounts
- Cloud Run traffic splitting with canary
- Artifact Registry build/push
- Cloud Monitoring alerting and rollback
- Pub/Sub to BigQuery integration basics

## Code Example
```bash
# Create SA
gcloud iam service-accounts create data-collector-sa --display-name "Data Collector SA"

# Bind minimal roles
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding my-project --member="serviceAccount:data-collector-sa@my-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/pubsub/subscriber"

# Build image

# Deploy to Cloud Run
```

## Why This Is Asked
Assesses real-world multi-region canary deployments, traffic shaping, and automated rollback using Google-native tools only.

## Key Concepts
- Kubernetes-based canaries with Cloud Deploy
- Artifact Registry as image source
- Per-region traffic controls behind a Global Load Balancer
- Cloud Monitoring alerting and automatic rollbacks
- Least-privilege IAM for deploy pipelines

## Code Example
```yaml
# Example (illustrative, not production-ready)
apiVersion: clouddeploy.googleapis.com/v1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: pricequote-rollout
spec:
  rolloutTarget: pricequote-prod
  strategy:
    canary:
      trafficSplit:
        - region: us-central1
          percentage: 15
          duration: 25m
        - region: us-east1
          percentage: 0
      postPromotionTraffic:
        - region: us-central1
          percentage: 50
        - region: us-east1
          percentage: 50
```

- What kind of IAM bindings would you apply to service accounts involved in the rollout?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to translate cost-conscious deployment into concrete steps using Cloud Run, traffic management, and billing alerts. Covers practical, beginner-friendly use of core GCP DevOps tools without abstract theory.

## Key Concepts
- Cloud Run autoscaling knobs: concurrency, min/max instances
- Traffic splitting and revision management
- Cloud Billing budgets and alerts
- IAM basics for service, CI, and billing visibility

## Code Example
```bash
# Enable APIs
gcloud services enable run.googleapis.com cloudbuild.googleapis.com

# Deploy v2 with autoscaling constraints
gcloud run deploy status-lookup-v2 \
  --image gcr.io/PROJECT/status-lookup:v2 \
  --region us-central1 \
  --platform managed \
  --concurrency 80 \
  --min-instances 0 \
  --max-instances 4

# Canary: 20% to v2
gcloud run services update-traffic status-lookup --to-revisions status-lookup-v2=20,status-lookup-v1=80

# 15 minutes later: 50/50
gcloud run services update-traffic status-lookup --to-revisions status-lookup-v2=50,status-lookup-v1=50

# Final promotion: 100% to v2
gcloud run services update-traffic status-lookup --to-revisions status-lookup-v2=100

# Billing budget alert at $50/month
gcloud beta billing budgets create STATUS_LOOKUP_BUDGET --billing-account BLAHBLA --display-name "StatusLookup Budget" --amount 50 --thresholds 0.8 1.0
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you automate rollback if the alert triggers during a canary?
- What monitoring would you add to verify correct behavior across regions?
